questions.stem: A 40-year-old woman presents with a 6-month history of recurrent chest pain, racing pulse, dizziness, and difficulty breathing. ECG recordings during episodes of tachycardia show a QRS duration of 100 ms, regular RR interval, and absent P waves. Which of the following is the likely underlying cause of this patient's condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Macroreentrant rhythm in the right atrium through the cavotricuspid isthmus

options.label: C
options.text: Fibrosis of the sinoatrial node and surrounding myocardium

options.label: D
options.text: AV node with slow and fast pathway
